feature_name: Showing rewards earned to the user against each transaction to reduce anxiety & doubts
sop_used: SOP: Card Transaction Dispute Management - Solution.docx
response:
# PRD SPECIFICATION: Transaction-Level Rewards Display

## 5. CURRENT STATE SUMMARY

Today, users earn PIXEL cashpoints on every transaction (5% or 3% on preferred merchants up to ₹500 per category per calendar month, then 1% up to ₹2000 per month), but rewards earned are not displayed at transaction level. When users exhaust category limits and receive 1% instead of 5%/3%, they contact customer support agents who manually calculate transaction-by-transaction rewards to explain the cashback amount. This creates customer anxiety, increases support ticket volume, and prevents agents from focusing on complex queries.

---

## 6. SCOPE

### IN SCOPE:
- Display of rewards earned on transaction detail screen post-settlement
- Display of provisional rewards on transaction detail screen post-authorization
- Calculation logic for category-wise cashback (5%/3%/1%) with monthly cap tracking
- Visual indicator showing which cashback tier applied (5%, 3%, or 1%)
- Explanation text for why specific cashback percentage was applied
- Category limit exhaustion status display
- Monthly cashback cap consumption display
- Real-time calculation of rewards at transaction authorization
- Final rewards confirmation at transaction settlement
- Support center view of transaction-level rewards breakdown

### OUT OF SCOPE:
- Predictive rewards estimation before transaction — requires merchant category prediction which is unreliable pre-authorization
- Historical recalculation of rewards for past transactions — data migration complexity and potential customer confusion about changed historical values
- Push notifications for category limit exhaustion — notification fatigue risk and requires separate notification infrastructure
- Rewards redemption flow modifications — separate feature with different user journey
- Changes to rewards earning structure or percentages — business policy decision outside this feature scope
- Integration with dispute management system — disputes are handled separately and rewards adjustment happens through existing dispute resolution flow
- Gamification or rewards progress bars on home screen — different UX pattern requiring separate design and testing

---

## 9. FUNCTIONAL USE CASES

### Use Case 1: Display Confirmed Rewards on Settled Transaction (Happy Path)
**Actor:** PIXEL Credit Card User

**Precondition:** 
- User has completed a transaction that has moved to SETTLED status
- Transaction merchant category is mapped to preferred/non-preferred category
- User's monthly cashback limits are tracked in system
- Transaction amount is greater than ₹0

**User Story:** As a PIXEL credit card user, I want to see exactly how many cashpoints I earned on each settled transaction with clear explanation of the cashback percentage applied, so that I understand my rewards without contacting customer support.

**Steps:**
1. User opens PIXEL app and navigates to transaction history
2. User taps on a specific settled transaction
3. System retrieves transaction details including merchant category, transaction amount, transaction date
4. System calculates applicable cashback percentage based on category limits consumed up to that transaction timestamp
5. System displays transaction detail screen with rewards breakdown section
6. User views rewards earned, cashback percentage applied, category limit status, and explanation text

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given a settled transaction on a preferred merchant where category limit is not exhausted, when user views transaction details, then system displays "₹X cashpoints earned" with "5% cashback applied" label and green checkmark icon
- Given a settled transaction where category limit was exhausted before this transaction, when user views transaction details, then system displays "₹Y cashpoints earned" with "1% cashback applied" label and explanation text "Your [Category Name] limit of ₹500 was reached on [Date]. This transaction earned 1% cashback."
- Given a settled transaction on non-preferred merchant, when user views transaction details, then system displays "₹Z cashpoints earned" with "1% cashback applied" label and explanation text "This merchant is not in preferred categories. You earned 1% cashback."
- Given a settled transaction that partially exhausted category limit, when user views transaction details, then system displays split calculation showing "₹A earned at 5% (₹B of transaction) + ₹C earned at 1% (₹D of transaction) = ₹E total cashpoints"
- Given monthly overall cashback cap of ₹2000 is reached, when user views transaction details, then system displays "₹0 cashpoints earned" with explanation text "Monthly cashback limit of ₹2000 reached on [Date]. No cashback earned on this transaction."
- Given transaction detail screen is displayed, when user scrolls to rewards section, then section appears below transaction amount and above merchant details with clear visual separation

**Failure State AC:**
- Given system cannot determine merchant category mapping, when user views transaction details, then display "Cashback calculation pending" with message "Rewards will be updated within 24 hours" and log error to monitoring system
- Given rewards calculation service is unavailable, when user views transaction details, then display transaction details without rewards section and show non-blocking error message "Rewards information temporarily unavailable"

**Priority:** P0

---

### Use Case 2: Display Provisional Rewards on Authorized Transaction (Edge Case)
**Actor:** PIXEL Credit Card User

**Precondition:**
- User has completed a transaction that is in AUTHORIZED status (not yet settled)
- Transaction authorization timestamp is within last 48 hours
- Merchant category is identified at authorization time

**User Story:** As a PIXEL credit card user, I want to see estimated cashpoints immediately after transaction authorization so that I have instant gratification and understand my rewards earning in real-time.

**Steps:**
1. User completes a card transaction at merchant
2. Transaction moves to AUTHORIZED status in system
3. User opens PIXEL app within minutes/hours of transaction
4. User navigates to transaction history and sees pending transaction
5. User taps on pending transaction
6. System calculates provisional rewards based on current category limit status
7. System displays transaction detail screen with provisional rewards section

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given a transaction in AUTHORIZED status, when user views transaction details, then system displays "~₹X cashpoints (provisional)" with information icon and "Pending" badge
- Given user taps information icon on provisional rewards, when tooltip opens, then display message "Final cashback will be confirmed when transaction settles (typically 1-3 days). Amount may change if merchant adjusts transaction value."
- Given transaction settles with same amount as authorized, when user views transaction details after settlement, then provisional rewards section is replaced with confirmed rewards section showing same amount without "provisional" label
- Given transaction settles with different amount than authorized, when user views transaction details after settlement, then confirmed rewards reflect recalculated amount based on settled transaction value
- Given transaction is reversed/cancelled before settlement, when user views transaction details, then rewards section displays "₹0 cashpoints" with explanation "Transaction was cancelled. No cashback earned."

**Failure State AC:**
- Given merchant category cannot be determined at authorization time, when user views pending transaction details, then display "Cashback will be calculated when transaction settles" without provisional amount
- Given category limits change between authorization and settlement (month rollover), when transaction settles, then recalculate rewards based on settlement date's category limit status and display updated amount

**Priority:** P1

---

### Use Case 3: Support Center Agent Views Transaction Rewards Breakdown (Failure/Support Case)
**Actor:** Customer Support Agent

**Precondition:**
- Customer has contacted support with query about rewards earned on specific transaction
- Agent has customer's account pulled up in support center
- Transaction in question exists in system

**User Story:** As a customer support agent, I want to see detailed rewards calculation breakdown for any transaction including category limits at time of transaction, so that I can quickly resolve customer queries without manual calculation.

**Steps:**
1. Agent receives customer query about rewards on specific transaction
2. Agent searches for customer account in support center
3. Agent navigates to customer's transaction history
4. Agent clicks on disputed transaction
5. System displays transaction details with expanded rewards calculation section
6. Agent views step-by-step calculation logic and explains to customer

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given agent views transaction in support center, when transaction details load, then display rewards section with "View Calculation Details" expandable section
- Given agent clicks "View Calculation Details", when section expands, then display: transaction amount, merchant category, applicable cashback tier, category limit status at transaction timestamp, calculation formula (e.g., "₹1000 × 5% = ₹50"), monthly cap consumption before this transaction, monthly cap consumption after this transaction
- Given transaction had split cashback calculation, when agent views calculation details, then display itemized breakdown: "₹300 remaining in category limit × 5% = ₹15" + "₹700 over category limit × 1% = ₹7" = "₹22 total cashpoints"
- Given agent needs to verify calculation, when viewing calculation details, then display audit trail showing: calculation timestamp, system version, category mapping version, limits configuration at time of transaction
- Given customer disputes rewards amount, when agent views calculation details, then provide "Copy Calculation Summary" button that formats explanation for email/chat response

**Failure State AC:**
- Given transaction rewards calculation has data inconsistency, when agent views transaction details, then display warning banner "Calculation discrepancy detected" with escalation button to L2 support and log incident to monitoring system
- Given historical transaction predates rewards tracking implementation, when agent views transaction details, then display "Rewards tracking not available for transactions before [Date]" message

**Priority:** P1

---

## 11. NON-FUNCTIONAL USE CASES

### Performance Requirements:
- **Transaction Detail Load Time**: Transaction detail screen with rewards information must load within 2 seconds on 4G network connection
  - **Acceptance:** 95th percentile load time ≤ 2 seconds measured via APM tools; test with 10,000 concurrent users accessing transaction details

- **Rewards Calculation Latency**: Rewards calculation for single transaction must complete within 500ms
  - **Acceptance:** Average calculation time ≤ 500ms, 99th percentile ≤ 1 second; load test with 50,000 transactions per minute

- **Category Limit Query Performance**: Retrieval of user's current category limit status must complete within 200ms
  - **Acceptance:** Database query execution time ≤ 200ms for 99% of requests; test with 1 million active users

### Security Requirements:
- **Data Access Control**: Rewards calculation details in support center must be accessible only to authorized support agents with active session
  - **Acceptance:** Role-based access control (RBAC) enforced; unauthorized access attempts logged and blocked; quarterly access audit review

- **Audit Trail Integrity**: All rewards calculations and adjustments must be logged with tamper-proof audit trail
  - **Acceptance:** Every calculation logged with timestamp, user ID, transaction ID, input parameters, output values; logs immutable and retained for 7 years per RBI guidelines

### Accessibility Requirements:
- **Screen Reader Compatibility**: Rewards information must be accessible via screen readers with proper semantic HTML and ARIA labels
  - **Acceptance:** WCAG 2.1 Level AA compliance verified; screen reader testing with NVDA and TalkBack; all rewards amounts announced with currency and context

- **Color Contrast**: Visual indicators for cashback tiers must meet minimum contrast ratio requirements
  - **Acceptance:** Minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio for text, 3:1 for UI components; verified using automated accessibility testing tools

### Reliability Requirements:
- **Calculation Accuracy**: Rewards calculation must be 100% accurate with zero tolerance for incorrect cashback amounts
  - **Acceptance:** Daily reconciliation report comparing calculated rewards vs. credited rewards shows 0 discrepancies; monthly audit of 1000 random transactions shows 100% accuracy

- **System Availability**: Rewards display functionality must maintain 99.9% uptime during business hours (6 AM - 11 PM IST)
  - **Acceptance:** Maximum 43 minutes downtime per month; graceful degradation when rewards service unavailable (show transaction without rewards section); automated health checks every 60 seconds

- **Data Consistency**: Rewards displayed on app must match rewards in backend ledger within 5 seconds of settlement
  - **Acceptance:** Real-time sync verification; automated reconciliation job runs every 15 minutes; discrepancies trigger alert to ops team

---

## 12. METRICS IMPACT

### Existing Metrics Impacted:

**1. Customer Support Ticket Volume - Rewards Category**
- **Current baseline:** Unknown — check with customer support analytics team for baseline of rewards-related tickets per month
- **Expected impact:** 40-50% reduction in rewards calculation query tickets within 3 months of launch
- **Owner:** Customer Support Operations Team
- **Measurement:** Track tickets tagged with "rewards query", "cashback confusion", "why 1% cashback" categories; compare 90 days pre-launch vs. 90 days post-launch

**2. Average Handle Time (AHT) for Rewards Queries**
- **Current baseline:** Unknown — check with customer support analytics for current AHT on rewards-related calls
- **Expected impact:** 30-40% reduction in AHT for remaining rewards queries due to self-service resolution
- **Owner:** Customer Support Operations Team
- **Measurement:** Track AHT for tickets categorized under rewards queries; segment by query type (calculation vs. redemption vs. other)

**3. Transaction Detail Screen View Rate**
- **Current baseline:** Unknown — check with product analytics for current % of users who view transaction details
- **Expected impact:** 15-25% increase in transaction detail views as users check rewards earned
- **Owner:** Product Analytics Team
- **Measurement:** Track ratio of transaction detail views to total transactions; measure daily active users viewing transaction details

---

## NEW METRICS TO TRACK

**1. Rewards Information View Rate**
- **Definition:** Percentage of settled transactions where user viewed transaction details within 7 days of settlement
- **Calculation:** (Number of settled transactions with detail view within 7 days / Total settled transactions) × 100
- **Target:** ≥35% within 3 months of launch, ≥50% within 6 months
- **Owner:** Product Analytics Team
- **Tracking Frequency:** Daily aggregation, weekly review

**2. Provisional Rewards View Rate**
- **Definition:** Percentage of authorized transactions where user viewed transaction details before settlement
- **Calculation:** (Number of authorized transactions with detail view before settlement / Total authorized transactions) × 100
- **Target:** ≥20% within 3 months of launch
- **Owner:** Product Analytics Team
- **Tracking Frequency:** Daily aggregation, weekly review

**3. Rewards Calculation Accuracy Rate**
- **Definition:** Percentage of transactions where displayed rewards match backend ledger rewards with zero discrepancy
- **Calculation:** (Number of transactions with matching rewards / Total transactions with rewards calculated) × 100
- **Target:** 99.95% accuracy (max 5 discrepancies per 10,000 transactions)
- **Owner:** Engineering Team & Finance Operations Team
- **Tracking Frequency:** Real-time monitoring with daily reconciliation report

**4. Support Center Calculation Detail Usage Rate**
- **Definition:** Percentage of support tickets where agent accessed "View Calculation Details" section
- **Calculation:** (Number of rewards tickets with calculation detail access / Total rewards-related tickets) × 100
- **Target:** ≥60% of rewards query tickets
- **Owner:** Customer Support Operations Team
- **Tracking Frequency:** Weekly review

**5. Rewards Explanation Clarity Score**
- **Definition:** User satisfaction score specifically for understanding rewards earned (via in-app survey)
- **Calculation:** 5-point Likert scale survey triggered after user views transaction details 3+ times in a week: "How clear is the cashback information on your transactions?"
- **Target:** Average score ≥4.0 out of 5.0
- **Owner:** Product Team
- **Tracking Frequency:** Continuous collection, monthly analysis with minimum 500 responses per month

---

## REPORTS & EXTRACTS IMPACT

### New Reports Needed:

**1. Daily Rewards Calculation Reconciliation Report**
- **Purpose:** Verify rewards displayed on app match rewards credited to user accounts
- **Frequency:** Daily at 2 AM IST
- **Format:** CSV extract via SFTP
- **Columns:** Transaction ID, User ID, Account Number, Transaction Date, Settlement Date, Transaction Amount, Merchant Category, Displayed Cashback %, Displayed Cashback Amount, Ledger Cashback Amount, Discrepancy Flag, Discrepancy Amount
- **Recipient:** Finance Operations Team, Product Team
- **Retention:** 7 years per RBI compliance requirements
- **Reconciliation Logic:** Flag any transaction where |Displayed Cashback Amount - Ledger Cashback Amount| > ₹0.01

**2. Weekly Category Limit Exhaustion Report**
- **Purpose:** Track how many users are exhausting category limits and when in the month
- **Frequency:** Weekly on Monday at 6 AM IST
- **Format:** Dashboard + CSV extract
- **Columns:** Week Start Date, Category Name, Total Users with Transactions in Category, Users Who Exhausted Limit, Average Day of Month Limit Exhausted, Total Transactions After Limit Exhaustion, Revenue Impact (difference between 5%/3% and
